defaults.source: Distilled from [developer.shopware.com](https://developer.shopware.com) plus the Shopware 6.7 source, retrieved 2026-08-20.

phpunit.title: Shopware PHPUnit testing
phpunit.description: Shopware PHPUnit: setup, unit and integration tests, Store API and Admin API tests, fixtures and builders, repository and config mocks. Use when writing a PHPUnit test for a Shopware plugin.
phpunit.intro: The PHP side. Integration tests need the kernel; unit tests need the mocks listed here instead.

javascript.title: Shopware JavaScript testing
javascript.description: Shopware JavaScript testing: Jest for the administration and the storefront, Vue component tests. Use when writing a Jest or Vue test for Shopware.
javascript.intro: Jest with Shopware's own setup. Administration and storefront have different configurations.

e2e.title: Shopware end-to-end testing
e2e.description: Shopware end-to-end testing with Playwright: setup, fixtures and the shop-specific helpers. Use when writing a Playwright end-to-end test against a Shopware shop.
e2e.intro: Full-stack tests against a running shop.
